import {NextRequest,NextResponse} from "next/server";import Stripe from "stripe";import {resolveAuthenticatedBuyer,getAppUrl,getStripeSecretKey,formatStripeCheckoutError} from "@/lib/checkout/server";import {getSupabaseAdmin} from "@/lib/supabase/server";import {DEFAULT_PROGRAM_KEY} from "@/lib/registration/types";import {enforceRegistrationCheckoutRateLimit,rateLimitResponseHeaders} from "@/lib/rate-limit";import type {PurchaseLine} from "@/lib/tickets/repository";
export async function POST(request:NextRequest){const auth=await resolveAuthenticatedBuyer(request);if(!auth)return NextResponse.json({error:"Sign in required."},{status:401});const rate=await enforceRegistrationCheckoutRateLimit(request,auth.buyer.userId);if(!rate.allowed)return NextResponse.json({error:"Too many checkout attempts."},{status:429,headers:rateLimitResponseHeaders(rate)});const body=await request.json().catch(()=>null);const lines=(Array.isArray(body?.lines)?body.lines:[]).map((x:any)=>({type:x.type,productId:String(x.productId||""),quantity:Number(x.quantity)})).filter((x:PurchaseLine)=>["ticket","addon"].includes(x.type)&&x.productId&&Number.isInteger(x.quantity)&&x.quantity>0);if(!lines.length)return NextResponse.json({error:"Select at least one ticket or add-on."},{status:400});const db=getSupabaseAdmin();if(body?.claimFree===true){const {data,error}=await db.rpc("claim_free_addons",{p_user_id:auth.buyer.userId,p_program_key:DEFAULT_PROGRAM_KEY,p_lines:lines});return error?NextResponse.json({error:error.message},{status:409}):NextResponse.json({free:true,orderId:(data as any).order_id,url:"/my-convocation"});}const {data,error}=await db.rpc("reserve_commerce_order",{p_user_id:auth.buyer.userId,p_program_key:DEFAULT_PROGRAM_KEY,p_lines:lines,p_registration_group_id:null});if(error)return NextResponse.json({error:error.message},{status:409});const order=data as {order_id:string;amount_cents:number};if(order.amount_cents<=0){await db.rpc("cancel_ticket_reservation",{p_order_id:order.order_id,p_user_id:auth.buyer.userId});return NextResponse.json({error:"Free content must be claimed separately."},{status:409});}const key=getStripeSecretKey();if(!key){await db.rpc("cancel_ticket_reservation",{p_order_id:order.order_id,p_user_id:auth.buyer.userId});return NextResponse.json({error:"Stripe is not configured."},{status:503});}const {data:orderLines}=await db.from("commerce_order_lines").select("name_snapshot,quantity,unit_amount_cents").eq("order_id",order.order_id);try{const stripe=new Stripe(key);const origin=getAppUrl(request);const session=await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({mode:"payment",customer_email:auth.buyer.email,client_reference_id:auth.buyer.userId,line_items:(orderLines??[]).map(l=>({quantity:l.quantity,price_data:{currency:"usd",unit_amount:l.unit_amount_cents,product_data:{name:l.name_snapshot}}})),success_url:`${origin}/my-convocation?ticket_purchase=success`,cancel_url:`${origin}/tickets?checkout=canceled`,metadata:{checkout_type:"ticket_purchase",order_id:order.order_id,program_key:DEFAULT_PROGRAM_KEY,user_id:auth.buyer.userId},expires_at:Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)+30*60});await db.from("commerce_orders").update({stripe_session_id:session.id,status:"checkout_created"}).eq("id",order.order_id);return auth.withSessionCookies(NextResponse.json({url:session.url}));}catch(e){await db.rpc("cancel_ticket_reservation",{p_order_id:order.order_id,p_user_id:auth.buyer.userId});return NextResponse.json({error:formatStripeCheckoutError(e)},{status:500});}}
